payload.name: Activity Duration Queries Include Event Memories
payload.description: When a question asks how long a recurring or typical activity takes (e.g., 'how long does X walk/run/do Y?'), search event memories and use duration-specific phrasing.
content: When a question asks how long a habitual activity takes (e.g., 'how long does Audrey typically walk her dogs?'), do not restrict the search to profile or state memories; include the event memory kind because routine activity durations are commonly stored as event facts.
Add query variants that include 'usually lasts', 'typically', 'about', and 'duration of [activity]' alongside the activity keywords.
If an event memory directly states the duration, stop searching and answer with that duration; do not substitute a related event date or unrelated activity.

solves: Questions that ask how long a habitual activity takes (e.g., how long someone typically walks their dog) fail when retrieval is restricted to profile/state memories, because routine activity durations are often stored in event memories. This skill adds event-memory search and duration-specific query variants so the answering agent can find the direct duration fact.
